continuity: Michael Silbert can absorb monsters’ magical power to grow stronger while maintaining and concealing mana within himself; Jin identifies him as effectively half-human and half-demon, and Michael does not deny the revelation.
Michael says Cheon Taemin once fixed his gaze on him and caused him fear; he avoided Lee Jungryong’s funeral in case Taemin was there.
Michael awakens a vast power in which darkness has increasingly overwhelmed the balance of light and darkness.
plot: Jin Taekyung confronts Michael Silbert with evidence that he can absorb monsters’ magical power while containing mana, explaining how Michael concealed his nature and grew powerful. Michael effectively confirms the revelation, recalls that Cheon Taemin once saw through him, then awakens a vast, increasingly dark power and declares that the only person he fears is absent.
translation_decisions: Keep magical power distinct from mana.
Render 지크프리트 바스만 as Siegfried Bassman.

active_continuity: Michael Silbert is exposed as someone who absorbs monsters’ magical power to grow stronger while concealing it alongside mana.
Michael recalls that Cheon Taemin once recognized him as a threat; he says Taemin is the only person he fears, but is absent from the gathering.
Michael has awakened a vast power increasingly dominated by darkness.
The Stone King’s identity as a monster has been revealed at the World Hunter Federation gathering, and Jin is protecting him as a friend and comrade-in-arms who saved his life.
Magic Johnson, Chuck Hagel, Faye Chen, Felix, and Choi Minwoo openly side with Jin after Fabian threatens him.
Fabian is the Guild Master of Kronos and an S-rank Hunter active since the Great Cataclysm.
Michael intends to lead the World Hunter Federation and has threatened to seek Jin’s permanent expulsion.
Cheon Taemin remains in a coma and too ill to join the coming war.
open_questions: Who will lead the World Hunter Federation, and will its members vote to expel Jin?
What will Michael do now that Jin has exposed his secret and what power has he awakened?
Can Cheon Taemin recover from his coma?

names.notes: Grand Mage and monster scholar whose research examined whether human bodies could contain monster magical power.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Michael Silbert is Odin Guild Master and a public hero positioning himself to lead the World Hunter Federation; he intends to eliminate Jin Taekyung as soon as possible.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Role:** Michael Silbert is Odin Guild Master and a public hero positioning himself to lead the World Hunter Federation, secretly able to absorb monsters’ magical power while concealing it alongside mana.

profile_updates.current: - **Role:** Jin Taekyung is the Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, Jeok Cheongang's publicly acknowledged Disciple, the Fire Gate Clan's nineteenth successor, the Pavilion Master of the Fire Dragon Pavilion within the Murim Alliance, a Supreme Peak master with the Heavenly Martial Physique and Force, and a publicly recognized S-rank-level Hunter who formally retains an A-rank license, as well as a traveler between Murim and another world resembling the realm of immortals and the principal Hunter opposing Michael Silbert's terrorist campaign.
